gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tags looked up by name should resolve to the same instance regardless of case, because HTML tag names are case-insensitive.
ADDED i2: Static valueOf normalises case via ParseSettings, so lowercase and uppercase resolve to equal tags
ADDED i3: TagSet.valueOf returns the canonical instance, so both lookups must be the exact same object
ADDED i4: Calling set() on a tag should apply the requested option and also implicitly mark the tag as known, because any explicit configuration counts as a definition.
ADDED i5: A freshly constructed tag is unknown and not void before any options are applied
ADDED i6: Setting Tag.Void makes the tag a void (empty) element AND automatically marks it as known
